name: Pebblet
lore: A pebble that pinches. Beachcombers learn which stones to skip the hard way.
prompt: Tiny fantasy hermit crab living inside a round speckled grey pebble, two small orange pincers, four thin legs, two black eyes on short stalks, and a patch of wet green algae on the pebble.

idle.action: Calm still idle, breathing very slowly and subtly, chest and shoulders rise and fall a little, feet planted, no other movement, ends in the same neutral pose it started in

walk.action: walk loop, full walk cycle in place, legs alternate naturally, normal calm walking pace, body stays centered, seamless loop whose last frame leads straight back into the first, no turning

south.action: Claw Swipe - Raises one front paw and performs one quick swipe forward, white swoosh lines following the claws, a big aggressive swing

south-east.action: Rock Burst - The crab launches its whole body up off the ground, both claws thrown wide, stone shards bursting out beneath it, an extremely violent attack, huge exaggerated motion, the limb thrown far out
